description: A bearded man in a white linen suit stands on a raised wooden platform under a large hanging bronze bell in a wooden frame, one hand on the bell rope and the other arm outstretched. Around him a crowd of dark-skinned men in worn work clothes raise machetes and hands toward him under a dark, smoky sky. Wooden plantation-style buildings line the background. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
